title: Traditional Song of the Highlands No. 102 (Rwai Shlur Ki Hima Vol. 15)
khasi_title: Rwai Shlur Ki Hima Ba-paka No. 102
cultural_context: Chronicles the defense of mountain states and ancestral autonomy. Passed down orally through generations of Khasi and Pnar families across Meghalaya.
lyrics_khasi:
U Tirot Sing u syiem ba shlur,
U la ieng pyrshah ia ki nongwei;
U ong: 'Kham bha ban iap kum u riewshlur,
Ban ia kaba shong mraw ha la ka ri!'
lyrics_english:
U Tirot Sing, the fearless ruler,
Stood resolute against the foreign invader;
He declared: 'Far better to die as a free warrior,
Than live as a subjugated slave on our own soil!'
